lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill region, organized into approximately six vertical columns with three to five clusters per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal luminance rows to form a repeating pattern of grid-like anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance above and a shadow-casting edge below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a dark, fusiform attachment on the mid-upper flank, posterior to the second vertical column of spots.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots that are more closely packed than the primary flank constellation.
